mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO knowledge_vectors ( document_id, embedding, content, metadata, chunk_index, chunk_hash, token_count ) VALUES
( #{r.documentId}, CAST(#{r.embedding} AS vector), #{r.content}, #{r.metadata, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}, #{r.chunkIndex}, #{r.chunkHash}, #{r.tokenCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT kv.id, kv.document_id AS documentId, kv.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, kv.content, jsonb_build_object('documentTitle', kd.title, 'source', CASE WHEN kd.scope = #{userScope} AND kd.user_id IS NOT NULL AND kd.type = 1 AND kd.file_status = 1 THEN '/knowledge-document/' || kd.id || '/download' ELSE NULL END) AS metadata, kd.metadata->>'docCategory' AS docCategory, (1 - (kv.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryEmbedding} AS vector))) AS score FROM knowledge_vectors kv JOIN knowledge_documents kd ON kd.id = kv.document_id WHERE kd.file_status = 1 AND kd.embedding_status = 3 AND kd.scope = #{scope} AND ((#{scope} = #{userScope} AND kd.user_id = #{userId}) OR (#{scope} IN (#{systemScope}, #{learningPathScope}) AND kd.user_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY kv.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryEmbedding} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}
